result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): A says outright that Starter is nearly the same as Free and suggests a concrete fix (500 to 1,000 pages). It also covers the Team–Agency gap and the misleading annual discount well, and spots that Team's page limit is ambiguous. B does better at saying what works (Team at $19 suits the typical freelancer) and gives a clearer numbered fix list with concrete limits. However, B misses the Free/Starter overlap and even recommends keeping Starter as it is. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): B clearly flags that Starter is nearly the same as Free and proposes a concrete fix. It also handles the $19-to-$249 gap more directly, with a mid tier for growing freelancers. A is stronger on saying what already works (the Team anchor) and gives a cleaner prioritized fix list, but it endorses Starter instead of flagging the overlap. Both handle the annual discount well, and both look only at Agency's crawl volume without noting that site and user counts do the gating.
